subject.title: fix(parallel): resolve env search key refs

question: Must this PR provide redacted live Parallel requests for the resolved and unavailable env SecretRef paths, or is its mocked lazy-dispatch proof sufficient for this pre-network credential-resolution change?
rationale: Source, sibling, and dispatch evidence support the implementation, but repository policy requires live verification for external API work and the contributor has no Parallel credential; only a maintainer can authorize an override.

options.title: Require live Parallel proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a credentialed run demonstrates env-SecretRef success and unavailable-reference failure with sensitive values redacted.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: Accept the mocked dispatch evidence because it observes the changed resolver output at the actual outbound header and zero-call failure boundary.
